recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is. Do not re-add Trial Use labels for FHIR-16461; future changes to supplement maturity or expansion semantics should come from later TI/Vocab work-group decisions, not this duplicate 2018 ballot item.
issue_request: FHIR-16461 was Published with a Not Persuasive with Modification resolution. The STU3 ballot comment asked for CodeSystem.supplements to be marked Trial Use because the element was new and had not satisfied maturity criteria, pointing to FHIR-14356; the final disposition said this was a duplicate of FHIR-16832, where Vocab decided to leave supplements normative and add a note that the impact of supplements on expansion was subject to future clarification.
initial_application: No standalone source commit mentioning FHIR-16461 or GF#16461 was found. The Jira comments say the work was done under the other task. The duplicate target FHIR-16832 was applied by historical commit 596446e2625e5d0b6cdf7dd11ffd36c9dd272e76, whose subject was "GF#16832 - warning about supplements effect on value set operation" and whose git-svn-id records SVN revision 14126; it added supplement-expansion warning text to CodeSystem and ValueSet guidance. The combined branch already contains a separate FHIR-16832 audit commit.
additional_context: The seed's referenced FHIR-14356 later directed a Trial Use marker for CodeSystem.supplements and the Code System Supplements section heading, but later Applied issue FHIR-39260 directed removal of Trial Use references for CodeSystem supplements. Commit 39f96b21ce8d65b5b086b3ee61a455e47a359a98 removed the CodeSystem.supplements standards-status extension and the CodeSystem section-heading Trial Use badge while retaining the ValueSet expansion warning family. CodeSystem and ValueSet are active current-build, Vocab-owned conformance resources with first normative version 4.0.0.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source already represents the correct post-family state for this duplicate: CodeSystem.supplements is not marked Trial Use, the Code System Supplements heading is not marked Trial Use, and source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml still warns that the impact of Code System supplements on value set expansion and validation is subject to ongoing experimentation, testing, and possible future rules.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-16461's resolution explicitly says the work was handled under FHIR-16832, which left supplements normative and added the expansion warning.
The seed references this earlier request to mark CodeSystem.supplements Trial Use; it explains why TU labeling was considered but is superseded for current source.
Later Applied R6 issue directed removal of Trial Use references for CodeSystem supplements, governing the current absence of TU labels.
